scope: Read-only re-review of revised B01 profile registry/snapshot plan; no product or test implementation.

original_b01_scope.details: The implementation remains within workflow registry, validators, and immutable profile snapshots. It prepares a server-side library that a future authenticated ingress can call; it does not add writes to the existing AX transcript API. B02 owns identity, authorization, database, and workspace isolation. B03 owns Temporal, outbox, durable waits, and process recovery. B04/B05 and real adapter/release work remain out of scope.

source_and_profile_contract.details: The field inventory covers the supplied example. The profile JSON Schema is explicitly new implementation schema. The example remains disabled mock; configuration completeness, operational checks, and approval are separate DTO outcomes. Neither enabled nor mock/real fields confer authority.

real_completeness_policy.details: The five required nonempty arrays are explicitly source.driver_paths, source.test_paths, build.artifact_patterns, device.sqe_expected_cases, and release.reviewers. The policy applies equally to every release mode; no skip or device waiver is inferred. Marker matching, paths for array markers, deduplication/order, and exclusion of explanatory validation/project_id are specified. Missing markers still do not imply that a reference exists or is approved.

workflow_identity.details: Registry identity binds exact raw bytes for workflow.v1.json, state-contract.json, and agent-contract.json against pinned source hashes, then derives a bundle hash. Snapshot identity carries all three source hashes and the bundle hash. Job.workflow_version is explicitly a lookup reference to immutable workflow_id; schema_version remains document-format version. Same ID cannot be rebound.

snapshot_and_publication.details: The deterministic snapshot envelope separates raw source hashes from canonical bundle/profile/payload hashes. The caller is captured synchronously; create-once publication uses temp write, file sync, close, hardlink, and directory sync. Equal-content retries sync before success; corrupt existing records and rebinding fail closed; uncertain outcomes preserve published bytes and can be resolved by verified retry. This follows the senior advice while keeping local-filesystem and non-tamper-proof limitations explicit.

public_api_and_error_contract.details: The Node library exports, sync/async behavior, result records, error codes, error privacy, CLI DTO/exit behavior, and filesystem dependency seam are fixed before TC authors test expectations. Library import has no side effects. The test seam is unavailable through CLI flags/environment and does not generate approval evidence.

independent_verification_testability.details: TC has independent ownership of test files and fixtures, must use literal expected values rather than implementation field lists/functions, and has explicit tests for parser/schema boundaries, fixed SHA/canonicalization vectors, caller mutation, independent-process races, sync barriers, fault injection, corruption/symlink handling, CLI privacy, and recovery. Stage gates state the purpose, target, method, responsible party, pass evidence, and failure recovery. Process-crash tests are not represented as power-loss proof.

controls_ui_gate_baseline.details: The plan now points to `evidence/b01/controls-baseline.json`, pinned to accepted commit 3e1136cef116753cf063dfb1725306b4b451aa80, archive SHA b33b53c5ca378a5b2881301f7f07f3ce839c21e39d2bc2359421374d015a8ec0, verification/review evidence, gate SHA ceb5e97c8411e225c9e450ad1f2ff692f0c2bffd7b19595c52929a7b4392fcdc, 169 historical source hashes, and 10 build/plugin outputs. The 11-command UI/browser gate is skipped only if current relevant source inventory and output bytes equal those pinned controls artifacts; otherwise affected checks run. The plan also avoids claiming all historical source hashes remain globally identical when package/lock/README changes are intentional.

acceptance_boundary.details: AT-04 and AT-28 remain not executed by B01 unit evidence. Full AT-04 needs X01 plan/skip evidence behavior; full AT-28 needs real-release enforcement. B01 completion is not described as B01-B05 or original AT acceptance.

remaining_limits: The source contracts do not provide an original project-profile JSON Schema; the planned schema remains a new implementation contract.
No production environment values or approvals are supplied. The plan does not enable the example or assert real readiness.
Local hardlink/directory-sync behavior depends on the supported filesystem. The plan explicitly excludes Windows/network filesystem and power-loss guarantees from this B01 verification.
reviewer_verdict: Approved for implementation after the separate TC preimplementation review is recorded against this exact plan SHA. Preserve the prior rejection as history; implementation must follow this reviewed revision.
